title: RelicTech Manual
summary: Use relics with respect for charge, cooldowns, identification, failure, and instability.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.body: RelicTech gives powerful tools with strange limits. A relic is safest when identified, charged, understood, and used for a clear purpose.

blocks.title: First Steps
blocks.body: Inspect relic data, confirm charge or cooldown, and test new behavior near base. Do not discover a failure mode while trapped in a hazard route.

blocks.title: Core Loop
blocks.body: Find relics, identify them, charge or stabilize them, use them for targeted advantages, and repair or cool them down before the next major route.

blocks.title: Important Systems
blocks.body: Phase anchors, matter stitchers, guardian lenses, echo mirrors, null batteries, and analyzer behavior all reflect the same rule: power has a state.

blocks.title: Integrations
blocks.body: Index can expose relic entries, Wiki can keep safe-use notes, TutorialCore can explain mistakes, and Nexus routes may reward careful relic preparation.

blocks.title: Troubleshooting
blocks.body: If a relic fails, read cooldown, charge, identity, and instability before trying again. Repeated failure usually means missing preparation, not random cruelty.
